title: Bekasi ka sheh ke charcha reh gaya
body:
Bekasi ka sheh ke charcha reh gaya
mujrayi mehmaan pyasa reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
kaatib aamaal bhi ruqsat hue
haye mai ghurbat me tanha reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr me hoga hisaabe zindagi
baad marne ke bhi jhagda reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr me rakh kar na tehra koi dost
mai naye ghar me akela reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jab hui be parda aulaade rasool
phir jaha'n me kis ka parda reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
teer gardan par jo khaaya dhoop me
bhar ke thandi saans bacha reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
so'oge kab tak bas ab utho 'anees'
Din bohot ghaflat me thoda reh gaya
